rules.ownership: Cars are owned per car model (since the 20-21 Oct 2026 Historic Update every livery comes with the car; liveries are no longer sold separately). Tracks are owned per track entry with all its layouts; separate year or version entries (Hockenheimring 2001 vs Modern, Laguna Seca Modern vs 1987, Spa 1995 vs Modern, Brands Hatch Indy vs GP) are separate store items. Packs are permanent bundles of cars and/or tracks, and owning part of a pack's content lowers its price. There is no subscription or premium tier that unlocks everything; the 'Premium Pack' is a one-off pack of all content at purchase time.
rules.notes: Needing both a track and a car is inferred, not officially documented: RaceRoom's own posts say a free series uses free content 'both the car and every track', and players report a ranked server stays locked if only the car or only the track is owned. Owning one car of an allowed class is assumed enough (not confirmed). Free-to-play ranked: the Alpine A110 Cup is paired with the permanently free tracks (Mantorp Park, Laguna Seca Modern, Twin Ring Motegi, Portimao, Sepang) in the daily races, and the whole Alpine A110 Cup ranked series is free. Every Wednesday one extra weekly free-to-play combo (one car plus one track, free in all modes for that week) is announced in the Steam post 'This Week in RaceRoom'; it changes weekly and is NOT in this file. Neither the ranked server feed nor the competitions JSON has a free or premium flag. Pack contents come from news posts, not from the store, because the new store app only reads data through an authenticated binary API. The Online Racing Pack Season 1 - 2026 is announced as 18 cars and 27 tracks but its list was not published; the entries here use the Oct 2025 Online Racing Pack list (18 car models, 27 tracks) minus Laguna Seca (now free) as a provisional guess (check). Season 1 ranked series also use hypercars/LMDh, WTCC/WTCR and more Super Touring cars that this guess does not cover. The Premium Pack, Starter/Pro packs and the limited-time Online Racing XXL, Xmas and Q3 2025 packs are not mapped item by item. Alpine Sim Racing Pack and RSTC Pack contents are inferred from 'contains everything required' wording. Prices are not recorded. Pack contents were read from the store on 2026-11-17 and replace the earlier provisional lists. Older packs that are no longer sold (Touring Car Pack, Super Touring Car Pack, Drivers Pack, Premium Pack) were dropped; owners of those can tick the items individually.
